name: Spider Sniper!
desc:
🕸️Swing. Snipe. Dominate.
Two fortresses. One sky. No escape.
No pay to win. All skill.

🪝 Fire your grappling hook and fly straight into enemy territory
🎯 Scope in from across the map and land the perfect headshot
🔫 Snipe, switch, finish. Sniper, pistol, and blade always have a role to play
⚔️ Storm their fortress or hold your ground, the action never stops
👥 Jump in anytime, team up, and bring the chaos

🔗 Join our community for updates and more!

🏷️ Tags: FPS, Sniper, Team Battle, PVP, Grappling Hook, Action, Fast-Paced

llm.loop: grapple into enemy territory -> snipe, switch to pistol or blade -> storm or defend a fortress in team battles
llm.objectives: win team battles between two sky fortresses
llm.instructions: fire your grappling hook, scope in for headshots, use sniper, pistol and blade, storm or hold your fortress; no pay to win
unique: grappling-hook swinging combined with sniper duels between sky fortresses
llm.thumbnails: red figure in a sniper scope, ornate red sniper rifle with RELOAD prompt, first-person grapple and shot, mid-air sniping
llm.complexity_notes: FPS weapon systems, grappling movement, team PvP netcode
